title: 23.2. Kusalattika, Vipākattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nakusalaṁ navipākaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ.
Naakusalaṁ navipākaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ.
Nakusalaṁ navipākañca naakusalaṁ navipākañca dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nakusalaṁ navipākadhammadhammaṁ paccayā kusalo vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nakusalaṁ navipākadhammadhammaṁ paccayā akusalo vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … dve.
Naakusalaṁ navipākadhammadhammaṁ paccayā akusalo vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … dve.
Nakusalaṁ navipākadhammadhammañca naakusalaṁ navipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṁ paccayā kusalo vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … dve. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nakusalaṁ nanevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā cha, adhipatiyā cha …pe… aññamaññe tīṇi …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate cha.
